requirements.boundary: Fixed deployment Windows account, protected project-only ACL, cross-session exclusion; updates/uninstall preserve school originals/layout per line154.

reusable_existing_code.facts: Existing runtime/instance.lock uses CreateFileW OPEN_ALWAYS and FILE_SHARE_MODE(0), excluding other live opens across sessions; file existence is not liveness. Owner is !Send/!Sync via Rc marker; Drop currently ignores CloseHandle result.

Normal composition verifies existing deployment ACL, pins runtime, holds InstanceGuard in the outer run scope through actual worker/writer/audio/shell close and joins. Fault paths terminate the owning process. Do not release an installer gate on logical shutdown request.
Independent repair also validates/pins the same root/runtime and acquires the same instance lock. A maintenance gate must cover repair and autostart, not only visible workbench startup.
Can reuse read-only root ACL/SID verification and pinning. The prepare methods create directories and must not be called by an installer merely to probe whether data/app is running.

Fixed HKCU Run value FutureClassroom; bounded REG_SZ+UTF16 validation, preimage compare, fresh check before mutation, factual readback and explicit errors. Production RunScope derives current_exe; scratch cleanup refuses production. Query/delete is explicitly non-atomic against external writers.
Existing app change coordination uses original shared worker and durable Prepared/Applying/factual settlement. PhysicalOwner is process-local only; it cannot serialize a separate MSI process.
Sensitive application writes require exact management SessionLease and active intent. Do not fabricate a login/admin Actor or initialize/open a school DB just to allow MSI uninstall cleanup.

confirmed_missing.gap: No maintenance owner spans an MSI transaction
confirmed_missing.detail: Current MSI deliberately forbids CustomAction and reports active-process refusal NOT_IMPLEMENTED. RemoveExistingProducts after InstallInitialize is only authoring order; it neither acquires nor retains the app exclusion lock.

Current production constructor targets current_exe, which in a custom-action/helper process would be the helper/MSI host, not the installed application. apply(expected,false) compares whatever eligible command the caller supplied; it is not an installer ownership decision proving expected==this exact installed product command.

confirmed_missing.gap: Strict external compare-delete is not implemented
confirmed_missing.detail: A replacement can occur after the last read and before RegDeleteValueW. Final Absent readback cannot prove a racing external replacement was not deleted. Existing app documentation honestly retains this window; do not label it atomic CAS.

recommended_next_cut.name: Native installer-maintenance owner and installer-bound negative-only Run operation, followed by explicit MSI integration
touchpoints: fc-windows: dedicated trusted installer lifecycle module reusing pinned path/SID and OS exclusion primitives
fc-windows/system/autorun.rs: factor bounded exact observations/command formatting without exposing arbitrary registry paths or reusing current_exe for the MSI helper
fc-bootstrap normal/--autostart/repair earliest entry: cooperate with same maintenance gate before data initialization/admission
MSI authoring/validator: add only the specifically reviewed lifecycle custom action/controller after its actual owner protocol exists
recommended_next_cut.held_lifetime_contract: Acquire exact deployment/installation exclusion before MSI touches program files, old-product removal or Run. Keep a physically live owner through file and registry changes, old-version uninstall, commit or rollback, final cleanup and actual action return. A one-shot check followed by dropping the handle is insufficient. Separate UI/execute/deferred/rollback/commit action processes cannot assume a shared Rust static/HANDLE. Choose and verify explicit owner handoff/retention; cancellation, action error, controller loss and close failure must not be reported as successful release.
recommended_next_cut.legacy_and_no_data_root: InstanceGuard::acquire creates runtime directories; do not invoke it for an absent ProgramData deployment. Need a separate bounded installation/account gate usable before data exists, plus compatibility with the existing root lock. Older binaries lacking the new gate and an absent deployment root are a real startup race; define the supported cooperative upgrade baseline or another proven exclusion method before claiming full protection.
recommended_next_cut.cross_account: Per-user MSI runs under the original deployment SID. Compare actual token SID, resolved per-user install location, existing protected deployment ACL/identity and intended registry view. Wrong SID/SYSTEM/elevated-other-account cannot silently fall back to its own HKCU, scan HKEY_USERS, adopt another data root or rebind DPAPI. Upgrade continues fixed path; do not delete a Run entry pointing at a moved ZIP/other product merely because its value name is FutureClassroom.
recommended_next_cut.run_cleanup_contract: Construct the exact installed EXE command from trusted MSI/installation identity and verified fixed location, not a form/current_exe/basename or loose prefix. Delete only the fixed value after exact REG_SZ type, original bytes including NUL, SID/view and command match; Absent is idempotent; foreign/Opaque/oversized/unreadable values are preserved and classified. Hold maintenance ownership so cooperating app processes cannot re-enable Run mid-uninstall. Bind cleanup to actual uninstall, not the old-product removal leg of a same-path upgrade; preserve desired startup behavior on upgrade and on rollback.
recommended_next_cut.external_toctou_decision_required: A cooperative lock does not exclude external policy/admin writers. If strict never-delete-a-replaced-value is required, implement and verify a genuine native transactional/atomic compare-delete mechanism and conflict handling before enabling deletion. Current plain RegQueryValueExW+RegDeleteValueW cannot provide it; if unavailable, preserve the Run item/return unresolved failure rather than claim exact cleanup. No new API support or atomicity was inferred in this offline audit.
recommended_next_cut.scope_limit: This is a genuine code/API and owner-lifecycle gap, not merely missing a Windows test report. Candidate build/table passes remain valid; full lifecycle/P5-03 remains incomplete.

necessary_future_validation: Actual separate-process lock contention across sessions: running app causes MSI refusal without close/kill/reboot; app/autostart/repair launched during every held installation phase cannot enter; resume only after actual final owner release.

Actual MSI full/silent install/repair/upgrade/uninstall, injected file/registry/rollback/action-owner failures, including cancellation between check and mutation; no one-shot idle probe accepted as full-lifetime evidence.

Synthetic owned registry scope only: exact owned REG_SZ, absence, other EXE/ZIP path, extra arguments, REG_EXPAND_SZ/opaque/type/NUL/size variants, replacement before compare and at the final compare-delete boundary; preserve unrelated values.
Original vs wrong deployment SID and registry view; no school DB/DPAPI/admin initialization by installer; own MSI marker cleanup is separate from Run ownership.
Real Win7/Win10/Win11 Q13 and separate Seewo visible/long-stability gates remain future evidence; no Windows runtime validation performed here.
